intro.narration: [excited] Heey, want the fastest way to do percents in your head?

steps.narration: [curious] Seven percent of twenty. Feels awkward, right?
[confident] Here's the flip. Seven percent of twenty is the same as twenty percent of seven.
steps.instruction: Flip: a% of b = b% of a

steps.narration: [excited] And twenty percent is just one fifth. So seven divided by five, one point four.

outro.narration: [warm] Try it on your own numbers, and tell me what you got.
